NONE: C1 with two parts, or combining two things
兩部分的；二元的；雙重的
› two sets of controls in a car, one for the person who is learning to drive and one for the teacher
（教練汽車的）雙重控制，複式操縱
› the nationality of two countries at the same time

example: This room has a dual purpose, serving as both a study and a dining room.
這個房間有兩個用途，既作書房又當飯廳。
the dual role of chairman and chief executive
董事長和執行長的雙重角色
She has dual British and American nationality.

NONE: › a road that has an area of land in the middle, dividing the rows of traffic that are moving in opposite directions
› able to be used to do two things

example: a dual-purpose lawn-raking and leaf-collecting machine
草坪耙掃和樹葉收集兩用機器

NONE: › the belief that things are divided into two often very different or opposing parts

example: Western dualism values mind over body.
西方的二元論更重視思想，而不是身體。

NONE: › the state of combining two different things

example: His poems reveal the duality of his nature, the joy and hope, the fear and despair.
他的詩揭示了他的雙重本性，既有歡樂且充滿希望的一面，又有恐懼失望的一面。
